PRIMARY.independent_evidence: Signed current report: T7 was repaired, rechecked and passed for unrestricted road service; the earlier fail is superseded.
PRIMARY.release_rule: Post UNRESTRICTED_PASS only when the signed current inspection disposition authorizes unrestricted road service. A failed inspection without a later repair and pass does not authorize it.
PRIMARY.common_prerequisites: The current inspection disposition is authenticated and belongs to T7. Posting authorization and every non-disposition documentation requirement are satisfied; no additional numerical or two-signature procedure applies to this posting.

PRIMARY-CARGO.description: Cargo associated with PRIMARY; standard route is available if released.

ROUTINE.description: Independent cleared cargo, own safe vehicle and route; standard meets its deadline. No disputed record dependency.
